brief: 5 morning rituals that changed how I run my business.

slots.headline: The morning rituals that changed how I run my business

slots.title: Phone-Free Mornings
slots.body: I leave my phone in airplane mode until nine. Those first hours belong to my thoughts, not notifications. The clarity compounds faster than you expect.

slots.title: Move Before Email
slots.body: Twenty minutes of stretching or walking resets my nervous system. Exercise before screens prevents reactive mode all day. I make better decisions by ten.

slots.title: Single Priority Block
slots.body: I calendar ninety minutes for my hardest task first. Protecting deep work early means progress even if the day unravels. Everything else waits.

slots.title: Silent Journaling
slots.body: Three pages of unfiltered handwriting clears mental clutter. It surfaces anxieties before they become fires. The practice takes twelve minutes and saves hours.

slots.title: Protein First
slots.body: A savory breakfast stabilizes blood sugar and mood. I avoid the mid-morning crash that used to derail meetings. Fuel determines focus.

slots.title: Cold Water Reset
slots.body: I finish my shower with sixty seconds of cold water. The shock dissolves residual sleep and builds resilience. It is the fastest mindset shift available.

slots.headline: Build your morning system
slots.body: Steal the exact checklist I use before nine. Small shifts create outsized results.
